name: owid
description: Work with Our World in Data: search published charts, explorers and articles, fetch chart data and metadata via the public web API, embed charts, and cite the original sources. Needs only curl and jq.

interface.shortDescription: Find, fetch and cite Our World in Data's charts, data and articles.
interface.longDescription: Search Our World in Data's published charts, explorers and articles across population, energy, climate, poverty, health, education and more; fetch the data and metadata behind any chart, with the definitions and caveats OWID's editors attach; embed charts; and cite the original data producers. Read-only, and uses only OWID's public endpoints.
defaultPrompt: Which Our World in Data chart shows global life expectancy over time?
